import sys

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def powerMod(a, b, mod):
    return pow(a, b, mod)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    ans = 1
    if k == 0:
        ans = powerMod(p, p - 1, MOD)
        print(ans)
        return
    visited = [False] * p
    for i in range(p):
        if visited[i]:
            continue
        j = i
        seq = []
        while not visited[j]:
            visited[j] = True
            seq.append(j)
            j = (j * k) % p
        d = len(seq)
        if powerMod(k, d, p) == 1:
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
